error.missingIssueToken: The issue token is missing. Copy it from your browser as described in the app settings.
error.badIssueToken: That does not look like a Nest issue token. It should start with https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/iframerpc and contain login_hint.
error.missingCookie: The cookie is missing. Copy it from your browser as described in the app settings.
error.badCookie: That cookie has no __Secure-3PSID value, which is the one the session depends on.
error.brokenCookie: The cookie contains a line break or control character, which usually means the paste was cut short. Copy the whole cookie value again as a single line.
error.notConfigured: Nest Protect is not set up yet. Open this app's settings in Homey (under Apps), paste the two values from your browser as described there, then add your devices again.
error.pairNoConnection: Homey cannot reach Nest right now. Check your internet connection, and that the issue token and cookie in the app settings are still valid.
error.noDevices: No Nest Protect devices were found on this account.
error.deviceGone: This device is no longer on the Nest account.

settings.title: Nest Protect
settings.intro: This app signs in the way the Nest app itself does, because Google's supported API does not cover Nest Protect at all.
settings.warning: The cookie is a full Google account session credential, not a Nest-only token. Keep it out of screenshots and bug reports.
settings.step1: Open home.nest.com in Firefox, sign in with Google and wait until your home appears.
settings.step2: Open the developer tools with F12, go to the Network tab and type iframerpc in the filter.
settings.step3: Click the shield icon at the far left of the address bar and choose Clear cookies and site data. Reload the page, and click Sign in with Google if asked.
settings.step4: Right-click the request whose address contains action=issueToken, choose Copy Value, then Copy as cURL, and paste it into the field above. Issue token and Cookie are filled in for you.
settings.step5: Close the window afterwards, but don't sign out of Google.
settings.curlPlaceholder: Right-click the issueToken request in the developer tools → Copy Value → Copy as cURL, then paste it here
settings.curlOk: Filled in Issue token and Cookie. Now test the connection.
settings.curlMiss: Couldn't find both values in that paste. Check you copied the issueToken request as cURL.
settings.cookieRotation: Cookie refreshed by Google: __when__ (__count__× since the app started)
settings.cookieRotationNever: Cookie refreshed by Google: not yet since the app started
settings.addonStep1: Install the setup helper in Firefox:
settings.addonLink: Nest Protect for Homey — setup helper
settings.addonStep2: Open home.nest.com in Firefox, sign in with Google and wait until your home appears.
settings.addonStep3: Click the add-on's icon and copy both values into the fields below.
settings.addonStep4: Close the window afterwards, but don't sign out of Google. Signing out ends the session.
settings.trouble1: Click the shield icon at the far left of the address bar and choose Clear cookies and site data. This only affects home.nest.com. Reload the page and sign in if asked.
settings.trouble2: If the add-on says the cookie is missing, switch off Enhanced Tracking Protection in the same panel and reload.
settings.manualTitle: Without the add-on: get the values by hand
settings.manualNote: If you see no issueToken request, switch off Enhanced Tracking Protection in the same shield panel and reload.
settings.chromeText: They have been tested and don't work for this. Since 2026 they tie your Google sign-in to your computer's security chip, as protection against cookie theft. Values copied from them stop working after about two and a half hours, and no app can renew them. Firefox doesn't do this. Safari on a Mac may also work, but hasn't been tested.
settings.chromeWarn: These values come from Chrome or Edge and will stop working after about two and a half hours. Use Firefox instead.
